scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.setup: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run create-local-user admin@example.com changeme Local Admin && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run make-admin admin@example.com
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "cross-env PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "cross-env PORT=20999 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/it-task-manager run dev"
